author: TEDx Talks
description:
What does a circle of schoolgirls in Brooklyn have in common with a movement that helped bring down the Berlin Wall? 

Psychologist and leadership scholar Wendi Williams connects two seemingly unrelated stories to explore where the power to create change begins, what it takes to keep going when there's no guarantee that our efforts will make a difference. In her work, Wendi Williams reimagines leadership by focusing on how power  is created. 

A psychologist, educator and leadership scholar, Wendi has spent her career examining how identity, power and belonging shape the way people lead and thrive. Her work challenges traditional models of leadership centered on authority and individual achievement, focusing instead on what becomes possible when people create opportunity for one another.

Wendi is president of the American Psychological Association and founder of The Well, a leadership development and consulting practice. Previously, she served as provost and senior vice president at
title: Where Does the Power to Create Change Begin? | Wendi Williams, Ph.D. | TEDxAtlanta

description:
A Broadway debut. A breakthrough TV role. An Emmy-winning documentary. What happens when every milestone still leaves you waiting for someone to say you belong? Actor Dyllón Burnside traces a question that reaches far beyond the stage. Dyllón Burnside has built a career telling stories that challenge who gets to belong, and who gets to decide.

An Emmy Award-winning filmmaker, actor, singer and writer, Dyllón is best known for playing Ricky Evangelista on the FX series “Pose.” Across stage and screen, his work has explored identity, belonging and the power of being seen.

Beyond performing, Dyllón is the founder of Soul Flower Farm, a Georgia-based creative retreat where artists reconnect with themselves, one another and the land. His advocacy also helped advance Georgia House Resolution 1007, recognizing the arts as a resource for mental health and well-being. author: TEDx Talks
description: Feeling pressured by peers who seem to have their entire career mapped out while you are still figuring things out? In this inspiring talk, Mr. Harshal Dilwali shares how an unexpected entry into the hospitality industry taught him that not having a definitive five-year plan is completely okay. From tackling humble, ground-level tasks to learning vital lessons from a wild snake dropping into a jungle property, Mr. Dilwali illustrates why early jobs do not need to be glamorous to be valuable. He reframes rejection not as permanent failure, but as an indicator that you are simply "not ready yet". Ultimately, he urges students to stop waiting for the right opportunity, start small, and let action and preparation guide them toward their true direction. Founder and CEO of Clarissa Group, an entrepreneur and advocate driving leadership, innovation and meaningful impact across diverse spheres. title: Starting Without a Roadmap: How Unexpected Turns Lead to True Aim | Mr. Harshal Dilwali | TEDxSRHU

Olajumoke Caxton Martins explores how leadership is shifting from individual authority to shared purpose. Through Life Mastery Academy and Dream Catchers, she empowers women and individuals to achieve financial intelligence and personal growth.

As Group MD of Abib Olamitoye Group, she leads a consortium of hospitals and hotels, while inspiring leaders and voices through her work as author, speaker, and coach

He challenges young people to stop competing in isolation and start building together, because collaboration is the most undervalued asset on the continent. Olubori Paul is a visionary businessman, finance coach, and mentor committed to empowering youths toward financial freedom and wealth creation.

As the founder of GO Holding, comprising Golearn, GoDigits, GoRealty, and GoFarms, he has hosted 7 finance conferences with over 15,000 attendees, trained 5,000+ forex traders, and helped over 1,000 youths build wealth through real estate and agriculture.

description:
Adolescente cherchant à disparaître, Mounia découvre avec le waacking une manière de prendre toute sa place et de devenir le personnage principal de sa propre histoire. En construisant un alter ego puissant, elle apprend progressivement à habiter son corps, avant de comprendre que la force passe aussi par l’écoute et l’acceptation de sa vulnérabilité. Aujourd’hui, elle transmet cette liberté aux autres : prendre pleinement sa place, sans empêcher quiconque de prendre la sienne.
Crédit musical : Amb3r D3sp0t  Figure importante du waacking en France et à l’international, Mounia Nassangar est chorégraphe, danseuse, modèle, DJ, productrice événementielle. Dansant depuis l’âge de 10 ans, elle est passée par le popping, le locking, le new style, la house dance, le dancehall et le street jazz avant de se spécialiser dans le waacking. 
Révélée au grand public grâce au Fashion Freak Show de Jean-Paul Gaultier aux Folies Bergère et au film Climax de Gaspar Noé, primé à la Quinzaine des réalisat

description: Putem fotografija i priča trudim se dočarati specifičnost i magiju putovanja u kontekstu planinarenja i ekspedicionizma. Ali prije svega, ukazujem na važnost ljepote samog puta prema cilju koji obuhvaća trening, posvećenost, motivaciju, okruženje kvalitetnim ljudima i kreiranje svakodnevice koja nas usrećuje. Dostizanje cilja nije cilj, već je sam PUT taj koji je važan. Put nas motivira da uživamo u svakodnevici, da ne padnemo u zamku praznine nakon što smo neki cilj ostvarili te da osvijestimo da živimo u specifično vrijeme kada imamo puno veće mogućnosti negoli su to imale prijašnje generacije.  Koprivničanac koji u svojim četrdesetima uspješno traži novu mladost i snagu po planinama diljem svijeta. Zakoračivši u svijet planinarstva na domaćoj Bilogori u djetinjstvu, njegove prazne stranice dnevnike ispisane su zanimljivim planinarskim pričama iz cijele Hrvatske, s Balkana, Alpi, marokanskog Atlasa, Kavkaza, iranskog Damavanda, Himalaja i Pamira. description: Odrastala sam u vremenu kada su posramljivanje i krutost u odgoju bili sastavni dio pristupa djeci. Kao mlada psihologinja gutala sam literaturu Jespera Juula. description:
What if the solution to food insecurity isn't simply growing more food?

In this thought-provoking TEDx talk, the speaker challenges us to rethink how we understand hunger, agriculture, and the systems responsible for putting food on our tables.

From farms and transportation networks to storage facilities and local markets, the talk explores how food security depends on much more than agricultural production. Food can exist in abundance while communities still struggle to access nutritious meals.

The presentation also highlights the environmental consequences of food waste, the importance of healthy soil, and the role of technology and data in building more resilient agricultural systems.

But beyond technology and infrastructure, the message is about responsibility. Every decision we make—from how we produce and distribute food to what we consume—can contribute to a more sustainable food system.

Food security is not just a challenge for farmers or governments. It is a shared respo
title: Growing the Future: Why Food Security Begins with Action | Precious Mato | TEDxNUTM

description:
Everyone sees the moment of success. Few see the years of effort that made it possible.

In this reflective TEDx talk, Michael Oyewusi explores the often-overlooked journey that takes place before recognition, achievement and public success.

Using the powerful illustration of an iceberg, he draws attention to the difference between the visible timeline of success and the invisible timeline of preparation, sacrifice and personal growth.

His message challenges us to rethink our relationship with recognition and to appreciate the importance of building something meaningful, even when no one is watching.

Rather than waiting for the perfect opportunity or the spotlight to arrive, he invites us to consider one simple question: What action can you take today? He's building design-led solutions at the intersection of tech, finance, and healthcare, showing how great design can quietly change lives.

description: AI could accelerate the discovery of new medicines, but how quickly will those discoveries reach patients? Drawing on his grandfather’s experience with Parkinson’s disease, Alex Epstein explores the growing gap between scientific progress and clinical development. He argues that reliable biomarkers and better trial design could help researchers evaluate treatments sooner. His call for collaboration challenges scientists, companies and regulators to bring greater urgency to the medicines patients are waiting for. Alex Epstein, PhD, is a senior computational scientist at Cellular Intelligence and head of research at Second Century Foundation. He earned his doctorate at Rockefeller University, where he used single cell genomics to investigate brain aging and caloric restriction. His work brings together experimental biology, computational methods and regenerative medicine to advance treatments for diseases associated with aging. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conferenc
title: Why New Medicines Take So Long | Alex Epstein | TEDxBoston Salon

description: La inteligencia artificial promete tomar decisiones por nosotros: más rápido, más barato y más eficiente. Pero ¿alcanza con que una decisión funcione? A partir de una caja de celulares en un liceo y de experiencias de presupuesto participativo con estudiantes uruguayos, Andrés Riva Casas propone mirar no solo qué se decide, sino cómo se decide. Muestra que una regla impuesta, aunque sea eficaz, es frágil, y que deliberar nos transforma. También plantea que la IA puede reemplazar la conversación democrática o ampliarla, según quién diseñe las reglas con las que la usamos. Porque la legitimidad no se decreta: se construye. Licenciado en Estudios Internacionales y magíster en Políticas Públicas. Docente universitario y especialista en gestión de proyectos, inteligencia artificial y transformación digital aplicada a políticas públicas. This talk was given at a TEDx event using the TED conference format but independently organized by a local community. Learn more at https://www.ted.com/ted
